notes.title: Small Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hey heroes!

Mayhem Heroes update 1.2 focused on improving the game's overall performance, in addition to the control assignment system in multiplayer matches. Also, the AI was too lazy to fight on the hard level, so we needed to [strike]bribe them[/strike] make an adjustment to the game so that the fighters fought like they should.

May chaos reign in the arenas!

Team Lucky Raccoon Games

notes.title: Big Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hey Heroes!

It is with great pleasure that we announce Mayhem Heroes update 1.1.0 \o/

This update focused on a general improvement to the game, making it more fun to play, especially in multiplayer mode.

Check out the full list of changes below:


[h4]Gameplay[/h4]
[list]
[*] Now you can customize the number of fighters (4 to 12) in versus mode, making everything more peaceful or extremely chaotic.
[*] It is now also possible to set the AI difficulty (easy, medium or hard), making your gaming experience more fun, according to your skill level and familiarity with the game. Difficulty will affect the AI's strength and reaction time.
[/list]

[h4]Local Multiplayer[/h4]
[list]
[*] Your friends who were eliminated will now respawn at the end of each wave in survival mode. This is the perfect opportunity for you to apologize to that friend you accidentally or "accidentally" threw a meteor at.
[*] No more confusion about which map will be chosen: it is now possible to play in a random map in quick match and survival modes :)
[*] The confusion about who will play which hero is also over: if two or more players choose the same hero, they will appear in different colors. Additionally, we started displaying each player's number above the character before the round starts.
[/list]

[h4]UI[/h4]
[list]
[*] The main menu has been completely remodeled, making it easier to configure matches.
[*] It is now possible to see which Steam profile is logged in on the main menu.
[/list]

[h4]Translation[/h4]
[list]
[*] Added full support for the Spanish language
[/list]

[h4]Fixes and Improvements[/h4]
[list]
[*] We fixed one of the achievements that was impossible to unlock (sorry for that)
[*] We also made several other fixes and improvements
[/list]

Did you like the changes? Tell us!
Good game,

Lucky Raccoon Games Team

notes.title: Found a problem? Report here
notes.content:
Hello mayhem hero!

We've been working hard on Mayhem Heroes to deliver the best experience possible for you on Day 1.

But if you find any bugs in the game (critical or not), we ask that you please report them through this channel. This will help our team in organizing and prioritizing adjustments, right? We count on your collaboration and understanding!

Thank you in advance!
